auth.description:
Authenticate via service account from https://console.cloud.google.com/ > IAM & Admin > Service Accounts > Create Service Account > Keys > Add key.

You can optionally use domain-wide delegation (https://support.google.com/a/answer/162106?hl=en#zippy=%2Cset-up-domain-wide-delegation-for-a-client) to access documents without adding the service account to each one.

**Note:** Without a user email, the service account only has access to files/folders you explicitly share with it.

userEmail.description: Email address of the user to impersonate for domain-wide delegation.

create_document.name: create_document
create_document.description: Create a document on Google Docs

aiMetadata.description: Creates a brand-new Google Docs document with the given title and writes the provided text into it. Use when an agent needs to generate a fresh document from content it has produced; to add to an existing document use Append Text instead. Not idempotent: every call creates a separate new document.

create_document_based_on_template.name: create_document_based_on_template
create_document_based_on_template.description: Edit a template file and replace the values with the ones provided

template.description: The ID of the file to replace the values

values.description: Dont include the placeholder format "[[]]" or "{{}}", only the key name and its value

images.description: Key: Image ID (get it manually from the Read File Action), Value: Image URL

placeholder_format.description: Choose the format of placeholders in your template

aiMetadata.description: Fills a Google Docs template in place by find-and-replacing placeholder tokens (e.g. [[KEY]] or {{KEY}}) with supplied key/value pairs and swapping placeholder images by object ID. Use when an agent has an existing template document and wants to merge data into it rather than build a doc from scratch. Requires the target document ID and the matching placeholder format; idempotent since re-running with the same values replaces no remaining placeholders and leaves the document unchanged.

read_document.name: read_document
read_document.description: Read a document from Google Docs

documentId.description: The ID of the document to read

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the full content and structure of a Google Docs document by its ID. Use when an agent needs to inspect, summarize, or extract text from a known document. Requires the document ID (not a name or URL); read-only and idempotent.

aiMetadata.description: Searches Google Drive for a Google Docs document whose name contains the given text, optionally scoped to a folder, and returns the first match. Use when an agent has a document name but not its ID and needs to resolve it. Idempotent only when used purely for lookup; enabling "Create a new document if not found" makes it create (and optionally move) a new document on each miss, which is a mutating side effect.
